fusions.name: Clamped Shut
fusions.desc: Clamps onto the target for 13 damage, stuns it for 1.2 seconds and leaves it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Twist Until It Tears
fusions.desc: Rolls with the target held in your teeth, dealing 16 damage and leaving it 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. It uses up every affliction you have on the target and deals 50% more damage for each one.

fusions.name: Jaws in the Shallows
fusions.desc: Sets a pair of toothed jaws at the nearest enemy. They wait up to 30 seconds, then close on the first enemy to come within 2 tiles in a blast that deals 22 damage.

fusions.name: Longer the Wait
fusions.desc: After 8 seconds without a critical hit, your crit chance rises by 40% for your next strike. Once every 8 seconds.
